newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Universal 1997 net seen at 1.0 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Universal 1997 net seen at 1.0 bln pesos.

text.p: Universal Rightfield Property Holdings Inc is expected to post a net income of one billion pesos in 1997, parent firm DMCI Holdings said on Tuesday.

DMCI President Isidro Consunji told analysts at a briefing the property firm's 1997 estimate of one billion pesos in net profit would come as a sharp improvement over the previous year in which the company is expected to post a profit of around 400 million pesos.
Universal will announce its full year 1996 results in March.
